chunks: If you could see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved, striking their faces and their backs, (saying): 'Taste the punishment of the burning fire.'

key_terms.يَتَوَفَّىٰ: take the soul / cause to die

ai.seo_question: What do the angels do to the disbelievers when they take their souls?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Badr, illustrating the divine retribution for those who rejected the truth despite clear signs. The striking of faces and backs symbolizes the complete removal of honor and dignity, while 'taste the torment of the burning fire' serves as both a present reality in the grave and a future promise in the Hereafter.
